title: 7 Deadly Sins : Reworked
description: A feature-rich Paper 1.21.1 plugin introducing 70 custom enchantments, raid bosses, progression systems, and party-based gameplay inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.
body:
# 🍎 7 Deadly Sins - Custom Enchantments Plugin 🐍💰

## ⚙️ Dependencies & Requirements

Before installing **7 Deadly Sins**, ensure your server has the following:

### Required

* **Paper 1.21.1+** (or compatible forks such as Purpur)
* **PacketEvents**
* **PlaceholderAPI**
* **ParticleNativeAPI**

Simply place all required dependency jars inside your server's `/plugins` folder before starting the server.

---

## ✨ About The Plugin

**7 Deadly Sins** introduces **70 unique custom enchantments**, each inspired by one of the Seven Deadly Sins:

* Wrath
* Pride
* Greed
* Envy
* Gluttony
* Sloth
* Lust

Built entirely for Paper 1.21.1, the plugin adds RPG-style progression, advanced combat mechanics, raid encounters, cooperative gameplay systems, and powerful character customization.

---

## 🎨 Refined Visual Engine

The latest generation of visual effects has been redesigned from the ground up.

### Features

* Optimized particle rendering
* Subtle and immersive visual effects
* Environment-based particle usage
* Clear combat readability
* Full projectile and melee compatibility

### Visual Standards

* 50–200 particles per effect
* Heavy use of Block and Item particles
* Minimal screen clutter
* Performance-focused rendering

---

## ⚔️ Custom Raids

Challenge powerful world events and earn exclusive progression rewards.

### Sinful Witch Raid

Summon a dark coven by sacrificing a Totem of Undying.

Fight through:

* 7 escalating waves
* Elite Illager encounters
* The Sinful Witch Boss

### Raid Features

* Native raid framework
* Inventory-based GUI management
* Admin force-start controls
* Unique rewards and advancements

Command:
`/raids`

---

## 📜 Sins Factor Progression

Track your achievements and unlock permanent account-wide bonuses.

Command:
`/sinsfactor`

### Example Advancement

**The Witch Slayer**

Rewards:

* +30% Damage Against Magic Mobs
* -15% Magic Damage Taken
* Immunity to Wither
* Immunity to Poison

---

## 🤝 Party System

Form groups and tackle difficult content together.

### Features

* Party creation
* Invites
* Member management
* Party chat
* Raid integration
* Shared progression systems

Command:
`/party`

---

## 🛠️ Commands

### Player Commands

* `/raids`
* `/party`
* `/sinsfactor`

### Administrator Commands

* `/7sins <enchant> <level>`

Permission:
`7sins.admin`

---

## 🌟 Core Features Summary

✔ 70 Custom Enchantments

✔ Seven Sin-Themed Enchantment Trees

✔ Custom Raid Framework

✔ Sinful Witch Boss Encounter

✔ Sins Factor Progression System

✔ Permanent Advancement Rewards

✔ Full Party System

✔ Modern GUI Interfaces

✔ Optimized Visual Effects Engine

✔ Paper 1.21.1 Native Support
